target: 100 times terminal isolated micellar same-analyte amount / initial food same-analyte amount
inner_rule: Up to three deterministically selected feasible study-purged category splits; otherwise up to three original-study GroupKFold splits. Require at least two inner splits. Never tune on outer test data.
primary_metric: Equal-original-study MAE, pooled over saved held-out rows
bootstrap_scope: Conditional approximate intervals, resampling original studies from fixed cross-fitted predictions; does not include refitting uncertainty
model_reporting: All prespecified families, no posthoc outer-score winner claim
eligibility_policy: No range/bound midpoint, no magnitude-based capping or deletion, source-verified graph central points included with flag. Unknown method evidence remains pending, rather than being asserted compatible.
grouping_limit: Original experimental source/linkage group; undocumented laboratory/sample overlap cannot be ruled out. Source DOI is not laboratory identity.
baseline_training_weights: Equal total mass per original study,1/n_rows_in_study per training row; weighted mean and median
feature_normalization: Source-documented canonical analyte labels plus existing reviewed aliases; source labels retained; no response, membership, fold, grid or seed changes
